title: Substitute
text: With $$u=x-100$$, $$x=u+100$$ and $$dx=du$$, so the integrand becomes $$\frac{u+100}{u}=1+\frac{100}{u}$$.

title: Integrate and back-substitute
text: This gives $$u+100\ln\left(|u|\right)$$. Since $$u=x-100$$ and constants can be absorbed into C, the answer is $$x+100\ln\left(|x-100|\right)+C$$.
